title: Cover Design: News Publications
slide_intent: Teach editors to distinguish the publication’s owner from its lead story so a reader can identify both on the front page.
strategic_value: NASA can connect center-specific and agency-wide news while allowing each issue’s image and headline to change.
demonstration: A compact Langley Researcher cover appears beside a larger NASA Activities cover. Each example separates masthead information from the lead material.
practical_value: Set the masthead hierarchy first. Choose the lead image for its content and graphic impact and check that the story reads after the publication identity.

content_islands.name: Priority guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the section title at upper left and the masthead and image-selection guidance in two adjoining columns.

content_islands.name: Center newspaper
content_islands.spec: Show the entire Langley Researcher example at left, including its compact masthead, columns and inset image.

content_islands.name: Agency news publication
content_islands.spec: Align the top of the larger NASA Activities cover with the newspaper. Preserve the large masthead, date, headline and dominant image.
